Gesture - tap.description:
Action: Briefly touch the screen.

Source: https://docs.nativescript.org/guide/gestures

Gesture - doubleTap.description:
Action: Two taps in quick succession.

Source: https://docs.nativescript.org/guide/gestures

Gesture - longPress.description:
Action: Press your finger against the screen for a few moments.

Source: https://docs.nativescript.org/guide/gestures

Gesture - swipe.description:
Action: Swiftly slide your finger across the screen.

Source: https://docs.nativescript.org/guide/gestures

Gesture - pan.description:
Action: Press your finger down and immediately start moving it around.

Source: https://docs.nativescript.org/guide/gestures

Gesture - pinch.description:
Action: Touch the screen using two fingers, then move them toward or away from each other.

Source: https://docs.nativescript.org/guide/gestures

Gesture - rotation.description:
Action: Touch the screen using two fingers, then rotate them.

Source: https://docs.nativescript.org/guide/gestures

Gesture - touch.description:
Action: A finger action was performed.

Source: https://docs.nativescript.org/guide/gestures
